query_normalized: llmxive follow-up: extending "when vision speaks for sound" computer science
rationale: The paper is canonical audio-visual cross-modal work — it studies associating semantic, acoustic, and visual cues, directly relevant to a follow-up on "When Vision Speaks for Sound" (audio-visual grounding/learning). It satisfies (a)/(f) as same-mechanism prior work on audio-visual semantic association, and it also provides the SoundSpaces simulation infrastructure commonly cited in this literature.
